description: This file defines the OrderBuilder class used for constructing Order objects in test scenarios. It provides methods to set various properties of an Order instance, utilizing OpenMRS services to fetch related data.

classes.name: OrderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and configuring Order objects for testing purposes in OpenMRS.

methods.name: OrderBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with default Order object and fetching OpenMRS services.

methods.name: withAction
methods.description: Sets the action of the Order.

methods.name: withPatient
methods.description: Associates a Patient with the Order based on patient ID.

methods.name: withConcept
methods.description: Associates a Concept with the Order based on concept ID.

methods.name: withCareSetting
methods.description: Associates a Care Setting with the Order based on care setting ID.

methods.name: withOrderer
methods.description: Associates an Orderer to the Order based on order ID.

methods.name: withEncounter
methods.description: Associates an Encounter with the Order.

methods.name: withDateActivated
methods.description: Sets the activation date of the Order.

methods.name: withUrgency
methods.description: Sets the urgency level of the Order.

methods.name: withScheduledDate
methods.description: Sets the scheduled date for the Order.

methods.name: withOrderGroup
methods.description: Associates an OrderGroup with the Order.
